title: Separate official proof-of-reserves membership, third-party wallet labels, incident-driven outflows and executable XRP liquidity
status: DESIGNED; DATA CROSSCHECK EXECUTED; OFFICIAL XRP POR CROSSWALK NOT VERIFIED
decision: Treat Bitquery's PoR address labels as secondary attribution until the official October 1 Binance address-download payload is parsed and all five XRPL addresses are matched exactly.
Keep CoinDesk's Ethereum Binance 14 PoR finding separate from XRP wallet membership; do not extrapolate ETH reserve impairment to XRP.
Treat TrackWhale's seven-day net outflow as incident-contaminated large-transfer activity, not voluntary holder withdrawals or net new capital.

Maintain separate features for exchange wallet transfers, executed spot/DEX volume, ETF creations/redemptions, derivatives liquidations, institutional custody, wrapped-token reserves and actual collateral deposits.
Keep Coinbase cbXRP reserve stock separate from net new XRP purchases; require a time series and mint/redemption reconciliation before calculating growth.
Keep fixCleanup3_5_0 as a proposed protocol change until code merge and validator activation are verified.
Do not admit the current asynchronous event panel into the prediction engine and do not issue a directional forecast.
rationale: Bitquery's report is more current than the prior 03:54 UTC observation and says approximately 233.5M XRP remained at the attacker receiver at 06:43 UTC.

CoinDesk's PoR investigation specifically identifies Ethereum Binance 14, while Bitquery's PoR label coverage is a secondary provider attribution; the five XRP wallets still require the official address-set crosswalk.
TrackWhale's seven-day outflow includes the Binance theft window, so interpreting it as a bullish exchange outflow would create event-label leakage and causal misclassification.
Coinbase's official cbXRP reserve snapshot is a real institutional custody relationship but is not a measure of fresh market demand.
The new XRPL restricted-token changes are not activated and cannot be represented as current production capabilities.
rejected_shortcuts: Do not infer that Binance's XRP reserve ratio is below 100% from the Ethereum Binance 14 finding.
Do not interpret -210.09M XRP tracked exchange netflow as voluntary investor withdrawals.
Do not equate Coinbase's 151.4M XRP cbXRP backing reserve with 151.4M XRP of new purchases.
Do not combine CoinGlass/CoinDesk and TradRadar liquidation totals without time/venue harmonization.
Do not treat the proposed XRPL restricted-token fix as active.
required_next_evidence: Retrieve Binance's official October 1 address-download payload and compare the five exact XRPL source accounts.
Identify the XRP-BF2 backing address from official or reproducible public records and compare it with the five sources.
Capture the November 1 Binance PoR snapshot and compute asset-specific reserve ratios only from matching liability/reserve definitions.
Monitor the attacker receiver and any subsequent XRPL destinations after the 07:23 UTC Bithomp observation.
Build synchronized CEX balances, order-book depth, executed spot trades, ETF creations/redemptions, OTC evidence and derivative positions.
Capture a historical Coinbase cbXRP reserve/supply series and distinguish mint/redemption from market purchases.
prediction_policy: NOT_ISSUED until synchronized point-in-time features, leakage-safe walk-forward testing, baselines, calibration and shadow evaluation pass.
